title: On Betting a week of wages on the race
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：bet　|　正文 376 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bet 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the keeper ① bet a week of wages on the race for the whole place, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② bets a week of wages on the race without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ bet a week of wages on the race at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ bet a week of wages on the race before — a line in the calendar for January 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Betting a week of wages on the race for the whole place, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ bet that he would come back without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Bet that he would come back at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ bets that he would come back for the whole place every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ bet a week of wages on the race again when nobody else would.

⑩ To bet a week of wages on the race, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody bets a week of wages on the race without a word of thanks again and somebody must bet a week of wages on the race for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打赌（一般过去式 bet a week of wages on the race：1991 年守夜人头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 打赌（一般现在 bets a week of wages on the race：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打赌（不定式 to bet a week of wages on the race：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打赌（过去完成时 had bet a week of wages on the race：1985 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打赌（动名词 betting a week of wages on the race 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 敢断定（bet that he would come back：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去敢断定他一定会回来）
G. v. 敢断定（bet that he would come back：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打赌（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 bets that he would come back，而母亲又一次 bet a week of wages on the race）

answers.why: bet 意为“打赌”，1991 年守夜人替所有人打赌一周工钱押在那场比赛上，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 bet。
bet 意为“打赌”，自那以后守夜人不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 bets。
bet 意为“打赌”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打赌一周工钱押在那场比赛上”，此处为不定式 to bet a week of wages on the race。
bet 意为“打赌”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人打赌过，故用过去完成时 had bet。
bet 意为“打赌”，守夜人说“打赌一周工钱押在那场比赛上这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 betting a week of wages on the race 作主语。
bet 意为“敢断定”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去敢断定他一定会回来”，should ever 之后用原形 bet that he would come back。
bet 意为“敢断定”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻敢断定他一定会回来（bet that he would come back at once），以后再也不要提起。
bet 意为“打赌”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例敢断定他一定会回来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 bets。
bet 意为“打赌”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人打赌一周工钱押在那场比赛上，用一般过去式 bet 叙述。
bet 意为“打赌”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要打赌一周工钱押在那场比赛上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

items: 1991 年，守夜人替所有人打赌一周工钱押在那场比赛上；钟楼里每一个过路人都说这是头一回。（bet a week of wages on the race）
多年以后，守夜人仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（bets a week of wages on the race）

早在 1985 年就有人打赌一周工钱押在那场比赛上，一月那天年历上的一行字就是证据。（had bet a week of wages on the race）
守夜人说过，替所有人打赌一周工钱押在那场比赛上这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（betting a week of wages on the race 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻敢断定他一定会回来，以后再也不要提起。（bet that he would come back，祈使句）
answers: In 1991 the keeper bet a week of wages on the race for the whole place, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the keeper still bets a week of wages on the race without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to bet a week of wages on the race at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had bet a week of wages on the race long before 1998, and the line in the calendar for January proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bet 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the keeper bet a week of wages on the race for the whole place, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper bets a week of wages on the race without a word of thanks whenever the tower asks.
Betting a week of wages on the race for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever bet that he would come back without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower bets that he would come back for the whole place every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother bet a week of wages on the race again, and the tower remembered that half.
